measured_bottleneck.observed_pattern: Manual inspection finds a mixture of real constraint failures and semantically valid answers rejected for surface phrasing, formatting, verbosity, or omitted arbitrary references.
measured_bottleneck.hypothesis: An independent prompt-conditioned judge can distinguish semantically useful complete Phi-3 targets from genuine errors, establishing whether ABI needs response extraction/semantic qualification rather than another source swap.

preflight.selection: Per capability, select one hash-ranked deterministic pass and one hash-ranked deterministic failure when both exist.

full.reason: The V83 raw source preflight failed and contains only search records; V85 diagnoses the response channel but cannot promote or derive a training artifact.

decision_rule: Run exactly one 28-record independent semantic diagnostic.
Require parseable, EOS-terminated, authoritative judge evidence for every row and observe both semantic passes and failures.
Do not reinterpret V83 as passed and do not build a training artifact from this diagnostic.

If semantic passes materially exceed deterministic passes among selected rows, preregister a successor extraction method with explicit answer-channel extraction, complete source responses, independent semantic qualification, and unchanged raw-output provenance.
If semantic judgments track deterministic failures, redesign the source prompts/data rather than adding post-processing.
claim_boundary: V85 can diagnose whether frozen V83 source outputs contain useful semantic supervision hidden by surface-form gates. It cannot qualify the V83 artifact, authorize LayerCake, or prove transfer.
